identity.pinRule: pinned once from the first released captured_live revision's payload (modelMode, codeVersion, inputProvenance.modelIdentity), before that slate's first capture; the protocol and its hash do not change

protocol.decisions: TJ direct pop-ups 2026-10-26 ~00:10Z, recorded in FORGE-QUAL/TJ-DECISIONS-RECORDED.md: D1 sealed block, D2 target and claim, D3 identity, D4 protocol, D5 no review before evidence

sealed.rule: no issued-row, readback or outcome reads for these dates; never used to choose target, threshold or method

population.source: forge_game_revisions rows selected by read_forge_game_revisions, horizon_games = 1, replayClassification captured_live, admitted by both consumers
population.rows: every skater row in those revisions; unconditional, so a skater who does not dress settles at actual 0
population.firstSlate: first slate after 2026-10-30 whose revisions carry this scope's pinned identity

readback.timing: once per slate at T-60 min before the slate's first puck drop

settlement.actual: shots_es + shots_pp + shots_pk (null if any is null)
rules: recordedAt after puck drop and after issue
a later repair is settlement version 2, never an overwrite

baselines.definition: player's season-to-date shots per game at cutoffAt, times the issued participation probability
previous released FORGE code version's revisions for the same games, where they exist

metrics.calibrationSlope: OLS slope of actual on predicted
metrics.deltaMae: MAE(FORGE) - MAE(season_rate), 95% bootstrap interval clustered by player and game
metrics.integrity: share of issued rows with a positive readback in both consumers; identity_mismatch and readback_unissued counts

protocol.resetRule: any producer change (codeVersion, configurationHash or artifactHash) ends this scope; a new scope is declared before its first slate
protocol.noTuning: no method, threshold or population change between looks; failed literal gates are reported beside any owner exception
